description: Running the reproducer through gdal_filesystem_fuzzer produced a non-zero exit (EXIT_CODE:1) but no AddressSanitizer/UBSan diagnostic or stack frames were printed. Without a sanitizer tag, access shape, or crashing frame, the fault type and sink cannot be determined from this log alone. The target is GDAL's virtual filesystem layer, so the trigger is presumably a crafted filesystem/archive input, but this is inferred solely from the fuzzer name.
title: Heap-buffer-overflow in gdal
